# Physical AI Sprint API

> Read-only JSON over the hackathon's teams and projects. No auth, no rate limit.

- [/openapi.json](https://www.buildspace.tv/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 specification
- [/api/index.json](https://www.buildspace.tv/api/index.json): endpoint index
- [/api/event.json](https://www.buildspace.tv/api/event.json): event details
- [/api/teams.json](https://www.buildspace.tv/api/teams.json): teams and rosters
- [/api/projects.json](https://www.buildspace.tv/api/projects.json): submitted projects
- [/auth.md](https://www.buildspace.tv/auth.md): authentication (none required)
- [/developers.html](https://www.buildspace.tv/developers.html): worked examples
